summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all stated requirements: all three retention policies (max-age, keep-latest, max-total-size), dry-run mode, input validation, error scenarios, and end-to-end GitHub Actions integration. Unit tests are deterministic and well-structured with excellent fixtures (New-TestArtifact helper, fixed reference date). Integration tests validate exact output via act. Minor gaps: some edge cases untested (tie-breaking for same-creation-date artifacts, Size=0, MaxTotalSize=0 semantics); integration tests hardcode policy JSON as inlined strings with implicit coupling to unit test reference date (2026-06-27) rather than explicit documentation; workflow structure tests verify file existence but not deep content. Strong regressions detection for policy logic, output format, error handling; would benefit from parameterized fixtures and explicit tie-breaking specifications.
